established_from_the_player_code_instead.finding: desktop Safari does NOT skip hls.js. The engine order is hls-js, then native-hls, then progressive; hls-js's condition is `mseSupported`, which probeSupport() sets from `"MediaSource" in window || "ManagedMediaSource" in window` — both true in modern Safari. native-hls is reached only when hls.js's own isSupported() DECLINES at import time, which removes just that engine
established_from_the_player_code_instead.consequence: the residual as written ('in Safari the <video> element consumes the HLS master natively, no MSE') is contradicted by the code: real desktop Safari takes the SAME hls.js/MSE path Playwright WebKit took in A40. A native-HLS lab must therefore force the decline (or use an MSE-less Apple browser) rather than assume Safari lands there
established_from_the_player_code_instead.no_override: there is no query parameter, setting or admin knob that forces an engine — selection is capability-only
still_unmeasured_in_real_safari: the original/progressive fallback when the HLS master 404s

open_findings_not_blocking_a_row: The login page offers 'Continue with Dex' and 'Continue with Bluesky' on an UNCLAIMED instance, next to the banner saying accounts are on hold. Both buttons complete a full provider round trip before being refused. Cosmetic, and the refusal is correct and honest — but the affordance promises something the instance cannot do.

A rejected applicant can re-apply simply by signing in through the provider again, filing a fresh pending request each time. This is parity with the password path (both pending unique indexes are partial), not a regression — but neither path has any re-application cooldown, so a queue can be re-filled indefinitely by one applicant.

PDS_DEV_MODE was required for a loopback lab: @atproto/pds refuses any http OAuth resource URL that is not localhost/127.0.0.1/[::1], so the A30-shaped 'public URL on a shim hostname' arrangement cannot be used for the OAuth half. The port-80 shim is still needed, but only for the handle -> DID hop.
